articles.title: Rahul Gandhi’s ‘Chhatron Ki Goonj’ vs PM Modi’s BJP Team Meet | Pune & Delhi Buzz | News18
articles.description: A busy political day unfolds with Rahul Gandhi’s “Chhatron Ki Goonj” student outreach programme in Pune and Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s first interaction with the BJP’s newly appointed national office-bearers in Delhi.Rahul Gandhi reached Pune on August 22 for the women-focused edition of “Chhatron Ki Goonj”, part of Congress’s wider student outreach campaign. The programme focused on engaging young women and hearing their concerns, with education, equality and social issues among the themes discussed. The event also came amid tensions between ABVP and NSUI members outside COEP University, adding a political edge to Rahul Gandhi’s visit.In Delhi, BJP president Nitin Nabin chaired his first meeting with the party’s newly appointed 65-member national team, with discussions centred on organisational strengthening, grassroots outreach and preparations for upcoming Assembly elections. The new team has 51 new faces, marking the BJP’s biggest organisational reshuffle in more than a decade.Prime Minister Narendra Modi later met the new BJP team at party headquarters and posed for a group photograph with the newly appointed office-bearers. Modi described organisational interactions as opportunities for “new ideas and perspectives” aimed at strengthening the party.The BJP is also stepping up its Gen Z outreach, with Nitin Nabin, Smriti Irani and Vinod Tawde among key figures associated with the new initiative. n18oc_super-saturday-debaten18oc_indiaCNN-News18 is your trusted source for breaking news, updates, and in-depth analysis from around the world. articles.title: US judge blocks Trump policy suspending visas for nationals of 75 countries
articles.description: A federal judge in New York has vacated a Trump administration policy that suspended the processing of visas from 75 countries, including Afghanistan, Iran, Russia and Somalia, whose nationals the Trump administration deemed likely to require public assistance in the United States. US District Judge Jeannette Vargas, an appointee of former President Joe Biden, set aside the policy Friday as "contrary to law and in excess of statutory authority." Secretary of State Marco Rubio exceeded his authority by issuing the policy, which "runs afoul" of the Immigration and Nationality Act by mandating "the refusal of visas to eligible applicants without any basis in law," the judge ruled. Vargas said the policy also undermines the congressional requirement that puts consular officers at the forefront of any visa decision. articles.title: 100 former French and British ambassadors accuse Israel of ethnic cleansing
articles.description: Former British and French diplomats are urging action over what they say is Israel’s ‘erasure’ of Palestine. The unprecedented joint letter directly accuses Israel of ethnic cleansing and warns that the world no longer sees it as a genuine democracy. Our correspondent in Jerusalem Noga Tarnopolsky tells us about the significance of this letter.
